sections.title: We help the people who bring strangers together.
sections.lead: Run clubs, supper clubs, quiz nights and courts are where a lot of people make friends in a new city. {{brand.name}} gives the hosts behind them better tools, so more nights happen and more people come back.

sections.title: The best nights run on a host’s spare evenings.
sections.body: Most of the nights people remember are run by one person with a WhatsApp group, a form and a spreadsheet. We build the tools that take that work off their hands: bookings, the door, the night itself and the follow-up.
ticks: Bookings and payments, with waitlists and applications
A door that checks guests in on their own phones
Live tools for each format, from pace groups to quiz teams
Reviews, reports and the people to invite back

items.title: Free events stay free
items.body: If nobody pays to come, nobody pays us. When you sell tickets, we keep 5% of ticket sales, never more than ₹10,000 a month.

items.title: Your guests are yours
items.body: Your list, your page, your followers. Export your contacts whenever you want.

items.title: A person, not a help centre
items.body: Message us on WhatsApp and someone from the team replies.

items.title: People before phones
items.body: The phone comes out at the door and between rounds. The rest of the night is for the people in the room.

sections.title: Where you’ll find us.
sections.lead: Open cities show what’s on this week. In the rest, ask us to tell you when your city opens.

actions.label: Want us in your city? Tell us

to.message: Hi {{brand.name}}, I’d like {{brand.name}} in my city.

items.question: Who runs {{brand.name}}?
items.answer: {{brand.name}} is built and operated by {{brand.operator.legalName}}, based in Indore.

items.question: How does {{brand.name}} make money?
items.answer: Hosts pay 5% of ticket sales, never more than ₹10,000 a month. Free events are free. Programmes such as offsites and retreats are priced per programme.

items.question: Do guests need an app?
items.answer: No. Guests book, pay and check in on the host’s page, in their phone’s browser.

items.question: Can I talk to someone?
items.answer: Yes. Message us on WhatsApp and a person replies.

items.question: How do I report a problem with a host or a plan?
items.answer: Message us on WhatsApp, or use the Help page. Our Safety page explains how we handle reports.

sections.title: Bring people together with {{brand.name}}.
sections.lead: Free for 30 days from your first event, or 90 for founding hosts. Free events stay free.
